title: Giraffe reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='65' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <!-- spots on body -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='61' r='3' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='71' r='2' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='23' y='74' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <rect x='33' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <rect x='44' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <rect x='52' y='74' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='23' y='88' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='44' y='88' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='52' y='88' width='5' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <polygon points='50,60 60,58 64,26 54,26' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='35' r='2.5' fill='#b5701a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='23' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f2b23a'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='25' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='25' r='0.9' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <rect x='57' y='12' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='11' r='2.2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <rect x='63' y='12' width='3' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <circle cx='64.5' cy='11' r='2.2' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='19' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='21' r='1.8' fill='#5a3300'/>
  <circle cx='64.6' cy='20.4' r='0.6' fill='#cfe8ff'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-12 40 80)'>
    <rect x='30' y='76' width='24' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#3f8fdd'/>
    <rect x='30' y='76' width='12' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#54a4f0'/>
    <rect x='41' y='77' width='1.5' height='13' fill='#2a5f9e'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='80' x2='39' y2='80' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='83' x2='39' y2='83' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='86' x2='38' y2='86' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='80' x2='51' y2='80' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='83' x2='51' y2='83' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='44' y1='86' x2='50' y2='86' stroke='#eaf4ff' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- arms/holding hooves near book -->
  <rect x='46' y='70' width='5' height='9' rx='2' fill='#e3a02e'/>
</svg>
